markdown.markdown:
Trustworthy AI, with a focus on **privacy**, **security**, and **robustness** in large language models (LLMs).
🛡️ **My work explores:**
- 🔒 Adversarial robustness
- 🔐 Differential privacy
- 💧 Watermarking techniques
to ensure reliable and ethical deployment of LLMs in real-world applications.
## 📖 Published
    Kieu Dang, Huy Phan, Ojaswi Dulal, Aiham Al Shukairi, Abby Shine, Chase Garner, Phung Lai. LLM Watermarking as Big Data Provenance: A Deployment-Oriented Systematization. In Proceedings of the 13th IEEE Special Session on Privacy and Security of Big Data, IEEE BigData (PSBD 2026). **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan, Yelong Shen, Ruoming Jin, Abdallah Khreishah. *𝛿-Steal: LLM Stealing Attack with LDP*. In Proceedings of Asian Conference of Machine Learning (**ACML 2025**). Dylan Tarace, Phung Lai, **Kieu Dang**, Unal Tatar. *AI-Powered Assessment of Wazuh for Obfuscated Threat Detection*. In Proceedings of IEEE Systems and Information Engineering Design Symposium (**SIEDS 2025**). **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai. *Navigating Trustworthiness in LLMs: An Examination of Privacy, Security, and Robustness*. In Proceedings of Computational Data and Social Networks (**CSoNet 2024**).
## 📝 Forthcoming
    **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, Ching-Yun Ko, Pin-Yu Chen. *Adaptive Co-Serving LLM Watermarking on Modern Inference Engines*, 2026. **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan, Yelong Shen, Ruoming Jin. *Robust LLM Watermarking with Minimal Semantic Distortion for IP Protection*, 2025. **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan, Yelong Shen, Ruoming Jin, Abdallah Khreishah, My Thai. *SoK: Are Watermarks in LLMs Ready for Deployment?*, 2025.
# 📜 Patents
    **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, Ching-Yun Ko, Pin-Yu Chen. * SWIFT Watermark Technique on Inference Engines* — Filed Non-provisional US patent, Oct, 2026. **Kieu Dang**, Phung Lai, NhatHai Phan. * SafeSeal Watermark Technique* — Non-provisional US patent, April 15, 2025.
# 🏛️ Research Experience
  • Research Collaboration – IBM Research Jan 2026 – Present
    🤝 Collaborating with IBM Research on trustworthy generative AI, focusing on scalable AI provenance and security.
    🔬 Developing LLM watermarking methods integrated into inference engines for efficient, deployment-ready provenance tracking.
    🛡️ Investigating provenance and attribution mechanisms for agentic AI workflows and multimodal AI systems.
  • Responsible AI Lab – State University of New York at Albany Jan 2024 – Present
    🤝 Collaborating with Microsoft, NJIT, KSU, UF, and HBKU (Qatar) on trustworthy machine learning experiments.
    🧪 Designing and evaluating adversarial robustness strategies for LLMs.
